profile: I write code for a living and for fun. I've spent the last few years building backend systems used every day by editorial teams at RTL, RedSeven and Bild TV: REST APIs, RabbitMQ messaging and SQL that doesn't fall over. These days I'm building Python services with FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React, with a soft spot for anything LLM.

experiance.title: Independent Software Developer
content: Build and ship full-stack applications end to end: FastAPI backends, PostgreSQL data models and React/TypeScript frontends.
Integrate third-party APIs into backend workflows, such as automatic task creation in Trello from processed meeting data.
Built a daily automated data pipeline that aggregates and scores job postings from multiple sources, with cheaper filters gating LLM calls to control cost.

experiance.title: Software Developer (Full Stack)
content: Developed and maintained production software used daily by major German TV broadcasters, including RTL, RedSeven and Bild TV.

Built event-driven form submission with RabbitMQ across a three-server setup (web, middleware, core system), with the public site publishing messages and the core system consuming them, so the two were decoupled.
Designed a self-service dynamic form platform where administrators configure fields and business rules themselves, removing developers and release cycles from routine client changes.
Fixed a performance bottleneck on a 100k+ record dataset by rewriting SQL queries and cutting memory use, reducing response times by ~60% and stopping the crashes it caused.
Owned client features across the full stack, from database tables and SQL through backend logic to the frontend, backed by PHPUnit tests and code review.

experiance.title: Working Student
content: Built a self-service talent portal end to end, from database design through backend to a JavaScript frontend, where performers register, manage profiles, upload media and apply to TV productions without staff involvement.
Led migration of multiple systems from PHP 5/7 to PHP 8.3 across a large, established codebase, resolving compatibility issues, refactoring deprecated code and clearing critical runtime errors.
Designed and delivered RESTful APIs using Test-Driven Development with PHPUnit, keeping large-scale data operations across casting and editorial workflows reliable.
Refactored a legacy codebase inside a custom MVC framework, applying OOP and SOLID principles to make it easier to extend and maintain.

experiance.title: Full-Stack Developer
content: Delivered new backend features for a school management platform and improved frontend integration.
Designed RESTful APIs and helped migrate a legacy PHP codebase toward Laravel, improving its structure and maintainability.

projects.title: AI Job Search Germany
content: Self-hosted job-search assistant that aggregates postings from multiple sources daily, filters them, and scores each against the user's CV with an LLM. Cheap deterministic filters run before AI scoring to keep API cost to a few cents a day.

projects.title: AI Meeting Minutes
content: Meeting management platform: a FastAPI backend transcribes audio with Whisper, summarizes it with an LLM and creates tasks through the Trello API.

projects.title: Vedic Astro App
content: Vedic astrology app with a RAG-powered AI chat assistant, using planetary chart data as retrieval context for a conversational LLM interface. Fully containerized stack deployed to Vercel and Railway.
